answer: Because the grove reference is updated at each ferrous checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the terrace audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 126 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 6 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
